final_results.rule: A missing or partial final report is INCOMPLETE: never success, never acceptance, never proof of cessation. An unavailable report names NO cause. And THIS VEHICLE PERSISTS NO PUBLICATION FAULT RELIABLY -- Shutdown.call writes its snapshot with earlier faults before running its step, the controller final publication is the last such call, and the outer publication handler records nothing -- so the absence of a publication fault is EXPECTED and informative in neither direction.
